Game Overview

Escape Lockdown is a escape game built around sneak through unusual prison cells, outsmart patrolling robots, and cleverly use your environment to escape in Escape Lockdown. Craft weapons, break objects for rewards, and carefully plan your moves in this engaging 3D escape adventure. Outsmart the system, or face capture and try again for ultimate freedom.
